jobs.description:
1 Senior Product Line Manager - OAM & Network Operations (m/w/d) Your tasks
 * Define and execute the OAM portfolio strategy and roadmap, aligned with business objectives, customer operational needs, market and technology trends, regulatory requirements, FRMCS evolution, and the GSM-R-to-FRMCS transition.
 * Manage the OAM portfolio across in-house 
 * Capture and translate customer, operational, market, standardization and regulatory requirements into product requirements and priorities and roadmap decisions.
 * Define and evolve OAM capabilities across network and service management, assurance, observability, fault, performance, configuration, inventory, software management and security, driving end-to-end visibility, service health, analytics and root-cause analysis across heterogeneous and multi-vendor environments.
 * Drive automation and intelligent operations across the OAM portfolio, leveraging advanced analytics and AI where relevant to simplify operational processes, diagnostics, troubleshooting and decision support.
 * Drive a consistent and intuitive OAM user experience, ensuring effective visualization of operational information and workflows.
 * Ensure interoperability and integration with customer OSS/NMS/IT environments and multi-vendor ecosystems through appropriate interfaces, APIs and data integration.
 * Drive OAM capabilities supporting GSM-R/FRMCS coexistence and migration, ensuring converged operability across both technologies throughout the transition.
 * Work closely with R&D, system architects and engineering teams to align technical direction and ensure products are designed for operability, maintainability, automation, diagnosability, upgradeability and long-term support.
 * Develop the OAM portfolio value proposition, positioning and support go-to-market activities.
 * Support sales and customer-facing teams through technical workshops, product presentations, proof-of-concepts, and strategic bid activities.
 * Monitor portfolio budget execution, ensuring delivery remains aligned with approved business objectives, priorities and financial targets

Your qualification
 * Degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline Several years of experience in Product Management, System Engineering or Solution Architecture within mission-critical communications.
 * Strong technical understanding of Operations & Maintenance systems for telecommunications or mission-critical communication networks.
 * Solid understanding of network management systems, OSS architectures, service assurance, and operational workflows.
 * Eperience with modern observability platforms and technologies, including metrics, centralized logging, distributed tracing, dashboarding and operational analytics (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, ELK/OpenSearch, or similar).
 * Experience defining operational KPIs, service health indicators and dashboards that enable proactive monitoring and service assurance.
 * Good knowledge of IP networking, virtualization, Linux, cloud-native architectures, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevOps practices.
 * Experience with railway communication systems, preferably GSM-R and/or FRMCS, or equivalent mission-critical communication environments.
 * Familiarity with cybersecurity principles, software lifecycle management, and secure operational practices.
 * Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate operational challenges into product capabilities that improve operability, troubleshooting, automation, and service quality.
 * Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers, operations teams, senior management, and engineering organizations.
 * Fluent English, German and/or French a plus

1 Senior Consultant (Mid-Level) - Focus Product Management (m/f/d) / Product Owner Tasks
As a Senior Consultant focused on product management at Trinsik, you own digital products end-to-end - from blank page to live, growing product. In our venture-building teams, you turn client and user needs into a clear product vision, validate fast, and lead cross-functional teams to ship.

What You'll Do
 * Define the vision, strategy and roadmap for new digital products, aligned with client business goals and validated against real user needs
 * Take products from scratch - frame the problem, shape the proposition, and validate before scaling; create new propositions, not just improve existing ones
 * Lead product discovery with user research, analytics, benchmarking and hypothesis validation; size opportunities quantitatively
 * Prioritize the backlog by customer value, business impact and technical feasibility, using clear frameworks
 * Lead agile teams across engineering, UX/UI, data and QA, coordinating with marketing, sales and operations for launch
 * Define success metrics, track them, and run an evidence-based cycle of experimentation, learning and iteration
 * Use generative AI and agents to accelerate definition, validation and prototyping - AI as part of how you work
 * Contribute to commercial outcomes - help ship revenue-generating propositions and deliver against targets

Requirements
 * Hands-on experience across the full digital product lifecycle - discovery, definition, delivery and measurement
 * Exposure to 0-to-1 work: you've helped create and validate new products or features, not only maintained existing roadmaps
 * 3-5 years in product management / product ownership for digital products
 * Commercially minded - you've worked to clear targets and are keen to own a number
 * Data-literate: fluent with product analytics, A/B testing and funnel/CRO optimization; you use data as evidence
 * A clear writer - your documents move discussions forward and help teams decide
 * High agency and comfort with ambiguity: you set your own priorities and move without waiting for a perfect brief
 * Strong stakeholder management with senior stakeholders and clients, written and verbal, in German and English
 * A growth mindset: curious, self-driven, and comfortable being challenged

Nice to have
 * Experience in venture building, startups, or innovation consulting
 * Technical fluency to dialogue with engineering (APIs, web/mobile architectures)
 * Product marketing or positioning background
 * Solid command of agile methods (Scrum, Kanban) and prioritization frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, ...)

Benefits
The Numbers: €60,000 - €70,000 gross annually (positioned according to your competencies)

Daily Perk: your choice: a public transport subsidy or a tax-free daily lunch allowance.

Permanent discounts with 600+ top brands via our Corporate Benefits platform.

Flexibility & Trust: Flexible hours and home office to balance life while keeping a vibrant team dynamic.

Change of Scenery: Work remotely from anywhere in the EU, up to 20 calendar days/year, or use sabbatical options.

Exciting Playground: Dive into different industries, apps and digital solutions with plenty of creative freedom.

Latest Software: We work with what's current. If you know something newer and better, let's test it.

International Team: An experienced crew in Austria, Germany, Hungary and Switzerland.

Flat Hierarchies: Your input finds open ears - from designs to business ideas or party plans.

Feedback Culture: open, and direct.

Cool Workplace: Collaboration happens right in the middle of Vienna.

Application process
We run a 3-stage process to understand who you are - and help you understand us. We position the role based on competencies, not titles.

OPTIMUSE is a Vienna-based AI startup revolutionizing the real estate and construction industry. We br... 1 Software Engineer - Engine Integration (m/f/d) Job description
Our Product Engineers are domain experts first, developers second. They build Engines - the simulations and models that capture how buildings actually behave - fast, and increasingly with AI. But these prototypes live on GitHub and only run on laptops: untested against the platform, unavailable to customers.

That's the gap you close. You're the key counterpart to our Product Engineers: you understand what an Engine computes, how, and why - well enough to decide where each piece belongs, hand off what belongs to other teams, and build the rest yourself. No finished spec lands in your inbox. You read other people's code, ask the right questions, and turn a working prototype into a service we can run and trust. We work in a strongly agentic way - so will you.

Your mission
 * Run our Engines and make them better - correct, fast, observable. When results look wrong, you can tell whether it's the data, the integration, or the physics.

 * Onboard new prototypes - understand the method and edge cases; judge what's production-ready and what needs a rewrite.

 * Find the right home for each function - decompose monoliths and define the interfaces and data contracts that make those boundaries real.

 * Integrate - with Planning and our Systems Architects, translating between domain and platform language, then build what remains yourself.

 * Make the next Engine easier than the last - shape the conventions that let prototypes arrive closer to integration-ready.

You won't do this alone: DevOps, App/Experience, AI, and Data & Flows already own their domains.

Your profile
 * Several years of professional software engineering across the stack, centre of gravity in the backend.

 * Python and TypeScript - strong in one, comfortable in the other, attached to neither.

 * The ability to read and judge code you didn't write, including scientific and numerical code.

 * A low-ego, collaborative style with domain experts, and the skill to explain trade-offs to people who think in physics, not architecture.

 * Professional English. German is a plus, not a requirement.

Nice-to-have

 * Geometry in code (computational geometry, meshes, CAD or BIM/IFC).

 * Simulation and numerical methods (thermal/energy simulation, FEM/CFD, solvers).

 * Real experience with AI and agentic workflows.

 * Productionizing research or prototype code (ML pipelines, scientific computing, quant models).

 * Building-industry or energy-domain exposure.

Why us?
 * Real impact. The Engines you integrate don't sit in a demo - they feed real investment decisions and move the platform forward in tangible ways.

 * The full solution chain. From digital twin to performance monitoring - you work across a complete product portfolio, not isolated one-off projects. Every Engine you bring in has a real place in the whole.

 * Flexible working models. Home-office option and a modern office in the heart of Vienna.

 * And the day-to-day works too. Daily meal allowance (€5/day), regular team events, free snacks.

 * Compensation: €60,000 - €75,000 gross/year, depending on your experience.

About us
OPTIMUSE is a Vienna-based AI startup revolutionizing the real estate and construction industry. We bring insights to the world's largest asset class that it never had before - both for new developments and existing portfolios. Our AI Hans delivers instant, deep engineering insight into costs, risks and optimization potential, grounded in building physics, simulation and engineering. Backed by international investors and a team of ~25 people from around 10 nations. Become a part of it!
